description: Get last events from the Netskope platform through the API v2
name: Fetch new events from Netskope

intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events

consumer_group.description: A unique name to track event consumption. It must not be shared with another connector. A dedicated index is derived from it for each event type (default empty for auto-generated one)

start_timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp (in seconds) from which to start the collection for a new consumer group. Without it, Netskope starts from the oldest available events

security_check_only.description: Collect only security-check alerts (malware, malsite, DLP)

arguments.title: The configuration to fetch new events
